# Licensed test fixtures

No media fixtures are included. Future synthetic or appropriately licensed fixtures may use media, MIDI or archive formats here without a global format ban.

Every fixture requires an exact relative path in [rights.json](rights.json), SHA-256, source/provenance, creator, license, redistribution permission explanation and purpose. Paths must be beneath this directory; no wildcards or blanket rights assertions. Review each new fixture manually. No user songs, full commercial lyrics, personal projects or model weights belong here. A manifest is evidence to review, not proof of legal permission.
